description:
इस वीडियो मैं मैंने आपको बताया है कि आप बिना ड्राइविंग लाइसेंस और RC के इंश्योरेंस पॉलिसी claim कर सकते hai

One question which is commonly asked is that, can you file a bike insurance claim without a driving licence? The answer is Yes. But the same can’t be said for a claim made without an RC. Because, it all depends on the terms and conditions of the insurer, but a claim can be made without an RC. In such situations, wherein you cannot produce the DL and RC due to loss/theft of the documents, the Loss of Licence or RC Add-on comes to your rescue.

When you file a claim for bike insurance, you have to produce the DL of the rider for the smooth processing of the claim settlement. Similar to a DL, the RC is equally important during a claim process. But what if the two-wheeler gets damaged even before it is registered? Or what if you do not have a DL as you are not riding the two-wheeler? If you have a Comprehensive Insurance Plan for your two-wheeler, then it will cover you in these tricky situations.

But what if you have lost the driving licence or RC and are unable to produce when filing a bike insurance claim? That’s when the Loss of Licence or RC add-on comes to your assistance

You can apply for a claim without the driving license/RC.

In case of loss/theft of DL or RC, the add-on will provide monetary compensation for getting the copies of the same.

The add-on can be bought at a nominal increase in the bike insurance premium.

You can purchase the Loss of DL and RC add-on when you buy Comprehensive online two-wheeler insurance.

The add-on will come in handy during the claim settlement process.

Adds a layer of protection for your documents such as Driving Licence and Vehicle Registration Certificate.
